args.sql:
WITH battery_efficiency AS (
    SELECT
        t.sessionregistry,
        t.battlifeh / t.battcapmah AS battery_efficiency_ratio
    FROM testsessions AS t
)
SELECT
    di.makername,
    di.modnum,
    t.battlifeh,
    t.battcapmah,
    iac.pwractmw,
    be.battery_efficiency_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN be.battery_efficiency_ratio > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
        WHEN be.battery_efficiency_ratio BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
        WHEN be.battery_efficiency_ratio BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
        ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
    END AS battery_efficiency_classification,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY di.makername ORDER BY be.battery_efficiency_ratio DESC) AS percentile_ranking
FROM battery_efficiency AS be
JOIN testsessions AS t ON be.sessionregistry = t.sessionregistry
JOIN deviceidentity AS di ON t.sessionregistry = di.devsessionref
JOIN interactionandcontrol AS iac ON di.devregistry = iac.interactdevref;

WITH battery_efficiency AS (
    SELECT
        t.sessionregistry,
        t.battlifeh / t.battcapmah AS battery_efficiency_ratio
    FROM testsessions AS t
)
SELECT
    di.makername,
    di.modnum,
    t.battlifeh,
    t.battcapmah,
    iac.pwractmw,
    be.battery_efficiency_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN be.battery_efficiency_ratio > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
        WHEN be.battery_efficiency_ratio BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
        WHEN be.battery_efficiency_ratio BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
        ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
    END AS battery_efficiency_classification,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY di.makername ORDER BY be.battery_efficiency_ratio DESC) AS percentile_ranking
FROM battery_efficiency AS be
JOIN testsessions AS t ON be.sessionregistry = t.sessionregistry
JOIN deviceidentity AS di ON t.sessionregistry = di.devsessionref
JOIN interactionandcontrol AS iac ON di.devregistry = iac.interactdevref;
